line: Instant email alert to innerwest@ whenever the bot captures a lead
Weekly stats report, Mondays 8am
Proactive greeting bubble (pops once per visit, ~10s in) + visit tracking
Fix: widget updates now reach returning visitors (browser-cache header)
Chat, greeting and session now survive moving between pages
Crawler filtering — the report now counts real visitors, not bots
Quick-reply chips on the greeting (Free trial / Timetable / Prices / Where do you meet?) — one tap starts the chat
Greeting copy A/B test: Robo-Coach's line vs the original, measured weekly
Ship log: every change that goes live now gets a line in this report
Widget version stamping, so update rollout to visitors is measurable
Weekly report now shows widget-version rollout and a four-week traffic baseline under one locked real-visitor definition
Human follow-up reporting now separates bot suggestions, explicit human requests and successfully sent owner alerts

Fix: owner alerts for "I want to speak to a human" now actually send. The database table that stops duplicate alerts had never been created, so every request was dropped silently. Verified end to end on the live site.
Storage health check now tests every database table, so a missing one shows up instead of failing quietly
The dashboard has a new home: outdoorsquad.realtiq.ai/admin (old link keeps working)
Report and lead-alert emails redesigned — cleaner layout, easier to scan on a phone
Proper sign-in page for the dashboard, no more browser pop-up box
You can now change your dashboard password yourself (top-right, “Change password”)
Security hardening pass on the dashboard sign-in (audit fixes)
The dashboard can now be added to your phone's home screen and opens like an app
Four-week baseline now labels the weeks measured under the old pre-24 July counting as not comparable, instead of mixing them in silently
Weekly report now reads its window straight from the database by date, so the earliest baseline week cannot quietly lose events as the data grows

Dashboard sign-in now takes your email address as the username (the old short username still works), and a Forgot password link on the sign-in page emails you a reset link so you can set a new password without signing in
Weekly report: the ship log and WhatsApp sections now appear every week, saying "Nothing shipped this week" or showing zeros instead of disappearing
Weekly report: your own test chats (the 31 Aug–1 Sep sessions from your three devices) are now excluded from the numbers, and future test sessions can be excluded the same way without a code change
WhatsApp: replies no longer race Twilio's 15-second webhook limit. The bot acknowledges instantly and delivers the answer as its own message, so a first message can never be silently dropped again
Price list answer: the "Roughly" hedge is gone (prices are exact), the Squad Student rate ($25/wk, verified students) is on the ladder, and the free-trial booking link is included
Timetable answers now always carry the live booking link, not just a mention of the booking view
"Do you have parking?" now gets the actual parking and transport facts for both venues instead of the location chooser
Weekly report: the WhatsApp section now states plainly whether the channel is live and publicly reachable, so a quiet week and a closed channel can never look the same
Weekly report: the greeting test now shows running totals since 6 Aug with this week's figures underneath
Owner alerts now go out by SMS from the business number as well as email
WhatsApp and website: handing over your details a second time (or adding an email after a phone) now gets a confirmation echoing what was saved, instead of a generic handoff line
"Where exactly is the Camperdown session?" asked right after a parking or timetable answer now gets the address, not a venue-choice question
Owner alerts: repeating the same contact details in one conversation no longer sends Nick a second identical email and SMS; new details still alert
Owner alerts: the enquiry type is matched on whole words, so "real person" is no longer filed as a kids/YTP enquiry
Owner alerts for "talk to a real person" now carry the person's name when they gave one
Robo-Nick's AI layer now runs on Claude Sonnet 5 (server-side model upgrade; nothing changes in the website widget)

Closed a gap where the public website chat endpoint could be pointed at a WhatsApp conversation by guessing the customer's mobile. Checked the logs: it was never used. The WhatsApp webhook now also ignores messages addressed to any number other than the Outdoor Squad one.

WhatsApp replies are now written for WhatsApp: the bot knows which channel it is on, introduces itself as Robo-Nick on its first reply, never asks for the mobile you are messaging from, and bold or links no longer arrive as raw asterisks and brackets.
If Nick flips the kill switch or replies by hand while the bot is still writing an answer, that answer is dropped instead of landing on top of his.
"Stop", "unsubscribe" or "don't message me" now get a one-line acknowledgement and switch off the follow-up for that thread.
The 90-minute follow-up no longer fires after a goodbye, after someone asked for a human, after a reply that failed to send, or outside 8am to 8pm Sydney time.
Owner alerts now say WhatsApp or Website, and WhatsApp alerts carry the number the person is writing from plus a reminder to reply inside the thread within 24 hours.
Fixed "messaging" being read as "aging": a parent messaging about their kid no longer gets the over-45 pitch.
Long WhatsApp answers are split into consecutive messages instead of being cut at 1600 characters; one number cannot flood the bot with unlimited messages.

WhatsApp leads now carry the number the person is writing from and the channel; on WhatsApp the bot asks for a first name only, never the mobile; alerts show the customer's WhatsApp display name marked as unverified.

WhatsApp: a customer who comes back after a day and a half starts a fresh conversation, so Nick is alerted again if they ask for him, the follow-up can fire again (at most three over the life of a thread) and a returning hi is greeted properly; older messages stay on the dashboard as background.

WhatsApp replies are now sent first and recorded only once Twilio accepted them, retried once when Twilio is briefly overloaded, and the replies sent over the API (the AI answers, the follow-up and your own manual replies) carry a delivery receipt, so the dashboard shows sent, delivered, read or not delivered; the instant scripted answers go back in the reply to WhatsApp's own call and are not receipted.
WhatsApp: two quick messages in a row now get one answer, in order, instead of two overlapping replies.

The Monday report's WhatsApp block now shows returning customers, requests to speak with Nick or Lyn, owner alerts, trial-link offers, follow-up nudges, replies Twilio refused or never confirmed, delivery receipts and the times the bot stayed silent on purpose; the dashboard's WhatsApp tab shows the same seven-day numbers.

WhatsApp review pass: someone who says stop is no longer answered by the instant scripted replies, a reply Twilio refused now shows as not delivered on the thread instead of showing nothing, the delivery badges land on the right message in a long thread, a returning customer's follow-up rules survive a restart, the bot can ask for an email again when a booking needs one, and a lead is never lost to a database column that is still being added.
